content.title: Tesla Stock Drops After Morgan Stanley Downgrade
content.summary: Tesla shares fell Monday after Morgan Stanley downgraded its rating for the stock, as well as for smaller electric-vehicle makers Rivian and Lucid.  The bank cut Tesla's stock to "equal weight," citing slower EV adoption and a choppy 12-month trading outlook, but raised its price target to $425, from $410.  Shares in Elon Musk's company dropped roughly 3% in morning trade.
